about: DCInside projectcc posts on main stages (not the Dimensional Rift), 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-07, captured in evidence/r2026-10-07/02-dc/dc by the DC stage lane (plus four stage-relevant posts the DC Rift lane captured: 81604, 81612, 81614, 82104). Shape of evidence/08-extract/BRIEF.md. recommended_power is the post-easing value from evidence/06-derived/stage-table.json (equal to curated/stage-chapters.json for -30 stages); bracket = team power as shown ÷ recommended power, by the 10/20/40/60/80/100/120% lines; a formation-screen power is marked as such. Cookies are named from the post text; battle-bar portraits that the text doesn't name are '?' (no portrait reference was available). Posts at relevance 0 have one-line summaries.

posts.title_en: Why accuracy became a scam: Seeker skill behaves oddly
posts.summary_en: 언담's test at accuracy 600 (301-3, Pomegranate Beetle): each Brightseeker drone volley rolls hit/miss on its first shot and keeps it (all hit or all miss). Scorpion rolls accuracy on every poison tick and a missed stinger adds no stack, so low accuracy cuts Scorpion twice. Witchberry, Choux Cream, Bari, Cherry Cola, Rye showed no such effect.
mechanics: Brightseeker drones: the first shot of a volley decides hit or miss for the whole volley (test at accuracy 600).
Scorpion: accuracy is rolled per poison tick and per stinger; misses lose stacks, so Scorpion needs accuracy more than others.
Without skill-haste gear Brightseeker fires 9 drone volleys per 30 s; the first is unbuffed.
